notes.text:
This update for coreutils fixes the following issues:

Security fixes:

- CVE-2025-5278: Fixed heap buffer under-read may lead to a crash or leak sensitive data (bsc#1243767)

Other fixes:

- ls: avoid triggering automounts (bsc#1221632)
- tail: fix tailing sysfs files where PAGE_SIZE > BUFSIZ (bsc#1219321)

notes.text: A flaw was found in GNU Coreutils. The sort utility's begfield() function is vulnerable to a heap buffer under-read. The program may access memory outside the allocated buffer if a user runs a crafted command using the traditional key format. A malicious input could lead to a crash or leak sensitive data.
